validation_notice: These draft rules have not yet been signed off by an agronomist. Every rule remains pending expert validation.

rules.recommendation: Inspect additional leaves and consult local agricultural extension guidance before making field-level treatment decisions.
rules.warning: A single image is decision support only and does not confirm field-wide disease.
rules.source_title: Conservative image-based rice disease decision guidance
rules.notes: General safety rule; requires review by a Bangladesh crop-protection specialist.

rules.recommendation: Continue routine monitoring and maintain balanced nutrition and appropriate water management.
rules.warning: Reinspect the crop if visible symptoms appear or the photographed leaf is not representative.
rules.source_title: Routine monitoring guidance for apparently healthy rice leaves
rules.notes: Pending agronomist confirmation of wording and regional suitability.

rules.recommendation: Retake the image and inspect additional leaves, or consult a local agricultural expert if symptoms are visible.
rules.warning: The healthy classification is below the confidence required for a reliable decision.
rules.source_title: Conservative image-based rice disease decision guidance
rules.notes: Inference-safety wording; not an agronomic diagnosis.

rules.recommendation: Inspect additional leaves, continue monitoring, and support balanced fertilization and field hygiene.
rules.warning: Brown spot can resemble leaf blast; compare lesion shape across several leaves.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice brown spot
rules.notes: Nutrient advice must be aligned with local soil and extension recommendations.

rules.recommendation: Inspect nearby plants, improve field hygiene and balanced fertilization, and consult local agricultural extension guidance for management.
rules.warning: Use only locally registered crop-protection products according to label instructions.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice brown spot
rules.notes: No product or dose is prescribed; local expert review is required.

rules.recommendation: Inspect additional leaves, avoid excessive nitrogen, maintain appropriate spacing, and continue monitoring during humid weather.
rules.warning: Leaf blast can resemble brown spot; verify the lesion shape and pattern on multiple leaves.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice leaf blast
rules.notes: Pending review of locally relevant integrated-management wording.

rules.recommendation: Inspect nearby plants, reduce avoidable crop stress, and promptly consult local agricultural extension guidance for integrated blast management.
rules.warning: Use only locally registered crop-protection products according to label instructions.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice leaf blast
rules.notes: No pesticide selection or application rate is supplied.

rules.recommendation: Continue monitoring, inspect additional leaves, and maintain field hygiene and crop-residue management.
rules.warning: Confirm whether symptoms progress from the leaf tip or margin before acting.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice leaf scald

rules.recommendation: Inspect nearby plants, improve field hygiene and airflow, and consult local agricultural extension guidance.
rules.warning: Use only locally registered crop-protection products according to label instructions.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice leaf scald

rules.recommendation: Continue monitoring, inspect additional leaves, and maintain balanced fertilization and field sanitation.
rules.warning: Check that lesions are narrow and follow the leaf veins rather than appearing broad or round.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice narrow brown spot
rules.notes: Fertilizer changes should follow local soil and extension guidance.

rules.recommendation: Inspect nearby plants, improve field sanitation and balanced crop nutrition, and consult local agricultural extension guidance.
rules.warning: Use only locally registered crop-protection products according to label instructions.
rules.source_title: Draft conservative management guidance for rice narrow brown spot
